understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by positioning the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked with a '+' was occupied by a selectable piece at the same time, producing a WIN state and progressing until the full game was cleared.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Actions were taken turn-by-turn with a limited step budget; MOVE_* would move the currently selected piece one grid unit unless blocked by walls/obstacles, while CLICK at a coordinate attempted to relocate/activate movement to that target square (and could fail if the destination/path was blocked or had no movement effect). Selection mattered because only the active piece responded to movement/click actions, and obstacles/walls prevented entering certain tiles, requiring correct positioning and sometimes switching targets to satisfy all '+' tiles simultaneously.
